The US is said to be preparing to provide Israel thousands of bombs that are among the most destructive in its arsenal, the largest single transfer of such weapons in years.
The potential arms transfer is worth as much as $2.8B,
reported. The proposed sale is just the latest in a series of Trump administration steps to improve Israel's military capacity.

The package includes as many as 20,000 MK-84s and 20,000 BLU-117s, as well as up to 20,000 I-2000 Penetrator warheads. The weapons are extremely lethal. The MK-84, for example, sends metal fragments in every direction for thousands of feet, causing giant craters and ripping through metal and concrete, reports said.
The Iran war has cost an estimated $33.4B as of June 29, according to a report on Operation Epic Fury from the lead inspector general of the Department of Defense that was submitted to Congress.
Iranian strikes destroyed or damaged dozens of U.S. aircraft and drones, including four F-15E fighter jets
and one A-10. Notably, the F-35A costs ~$92M per plane, and the F-15E costs over $60M per unit.

title: Trump’s panned bomb sale to Israel said to be largest in years
